summary: National Fuel Gas Company filed an 8-K reporting that the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio (PUCO) has approved its previously announced acquisition of Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio, LLC from CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp. The aggregate purchase price is $2,620,000,000, subject to customary adjustments. The acquisition is for all equity interests of the Ohio natural gas local distribution company. The board of National Fuel Gas has recommended the transaction. The regulatory approval from PUCO, a key closing condition, has now been obtained. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of calendar 2026, but not before October 1, 2026 without the Seller's consent. Watch for remaining closing conditions and the exact closing date; the risk-arb angle is minimal as regulatory approval is secured.
